_comment: Node id -> resolvable question for the daily Oracle series (retro#577). Keys are <graph>.<node_id>; `caseA` nodes come from audits/oracle-v2-manual-decomposition-2026-08-21.md. Election day assumed 2026-10-27 unless the Knesset sets an earlier date.

political.TRUMP_BACK: Will Donald Trump publicly endorse Benjamin Netanyahu before the next Israeli Knesset election (by 27 Oct 2026)?
political.IRAN_REB: Will credible reporting (IAEA or major outlets) confirm that Iran has resumed uranium enrichment at 60% or above by 31 Dec 2026?
political.BEYACHAD: Will the Bennett-led opposition alliance (Beyachad / Bennett–Eisenkot–Lapid partners) run as a single joint list in the next Knesset election (by 27 Oct 2026)?
political.LIKUD_UNITY: Will Likud run as a single united list, with no breakaway faction of sitting Likud MKs, in the next Knesset election (by 27 Oct 2026)?
political.HAREDI_CRISIS: Will the Haredi draft-law crisis still be unresolved (no exemption law passed and Haredi parties outside or threatening the coalition) on 1 Oct 2026?
political.BIBI_OUT: Will Benjamin Netanyahu cease to serve as Prime Minister of Israel for reasons of health, death or criminal conviction before 31 Dec 2026?
political.EARLY_ELECTION: Will Israel hold a Knesset election before 27 Oct 2026?
political.POLL_LEAD: Will the Netanyahu bloc (Likud, Shas, UTJ, Religious Zionism, Otzma Yehudit) lead the opposition bloc in the Channel 12 poll average during the final week before the next Knesset election?
political.RIGHT_BLOC_61: Will the Netanyahu bloc (Likud, Shas, UTJ, Religious Zionism, Otzma Yehudit) win 61 or more Knesset seats in the next Israeli election (by 27 Oct 2026)?
political.LIKUD_LARGEST: Will Likud win the most seats of any single list in the next Israeli Knesset election (by 27 Oct 2026)?
political.HAREDI_J: Will Shas and United Torah Judaism both join the governing coalition formed after the next Knesset election (by 31 Mar 2027)?
political.FARRIGHT_J: Will Religious Zionism (Smotrich) or Otzma Yehudit (Ben Gvir) join the governing coalition formed after the next Knesset election (by 31 Mar 2027)?
political.COAL_FORMED: Will Benjamin Netanyahu successfully form a government after the next Knesset election (by 31 Mar 2027)?
political.BIBI_PM: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be the Prime Minister of Israel on 1 Apr 2027?
political.OPP_GOVT: Will a government led by Naftali Bennett, Yair Lapid or Gadi Eisenkot be sworn in after the next Knesset election (by 31 Mar 2027)?
political.OTHER_LIKUD_PM: Will a Likud member other than Benjamin Netanyahu be Prime Minister of Israel on 1 Apr 2027?
political.PARDON: Will Israel's President grant Benjamin Netanyahu a pardon in his criminal cases before 31 Dec 2026?
political.JUDICIAL: Will the Knesset pass a first reading of a new judicial-overhaul bill (judicial selection, override or reasonableness) before 31 Dec 2026?
political.HAREDI_LAW: Will the Knesset pass into law a Haredi military-draft exemption or deferral bill before 27 Oct 2026?
political.SAUDI: Will Israel and Saudi Arabia sign a normalization agreement before 31 Dec 2026?
political.IRAN2: Will Israel conduct a new large-scale military strike on Iranian territory before 31 Dec 2026?
